raw.description:
Lead Software Engineer in Test

CD Baby — Platform Team

About Us

CD Baby is a globally recognized leader in the music industry and the first platform to offer artists direct distribution to their fans. Our technology organization has a deep history and a strong foundation, built by long-tenured, dedicated professionals. As we navigate the next era of music technology, we are committed to modernizing our core systems, fostering an agile culture, and leveraging cutting-edge platforms to better serve our artists, partners, and fans worldwide.

The Role

We are seeking a Lead Software Engineer in Test to be the senior-most quality voice on CD Baby’s flagship customer-facing software: the members application our artists use to distribute their music, get paid, and understand their audiences, and the .com marketing site that brings new artists into the platform. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with broad technical authority over how we test — the engineer who treats quality as a software engineering discipline and builds the practice to prove it.

In the near term, you will help carry our customer-facing platform across the finish line for a brand relaunch worthy of CD Baby — standing up the automated coverage, the test data, and the CI/CD gates that let us ship with confidence. Beyond launch, your defining mandate is to architect our testing practice from the ground up: choose the frameworks, build the suites, integrate them into our delivery pipeline, and make automated, AI-augmented testing a first-class capability of the team as our customer-facing stack evolves from a .NET monolith into a modular, API-driven, service-based architecture.

This is a role for an engineer who is energized by both the discipline of writing the code that proves our software works every day, and the craft of designing a testing program that scales with the platform underneath it.

What You’ll Own

Testing Strategy & Practice

  • Define and drive the multi-year evolution of CD Baby’s automated testing practice — from a nascent Playwright-based program today to a comprehensive, AI-augmented testing capability that scales as our architecture moves from monolith to services.
  • Choose the right tools for each layer of the test pyramid: UI/end-to-end (currently Playwright), API and contract testing, integration testing across our third-party API seams (FUGA, Zendesk, Trolley, and others integral to our operations), and performance and load testing. Bring a clear point of view on what to use, why, and how it fits together.
  • Design and own the CI/CD test integration. Our pipeline runs on ArgoCD; you will define how tests gate every release, what runs where, how fast feedback loops are kept fast, and how the suite earns trust over time.
  • Establish test data strategy, environment management, and the engineering patterns that keep tests reliable as the surface area grows.

Building the Test Suite

  • Own the test suite for the entire flagship application. The primary job here is writing the code — the tests, the fixtures, the helpers, the harnesses — that proves the member application and the .com marketing site work as our customers expect, release after release.
  • Cover the .NET monolith we operate today, the Next.js front end, and the new services as they emerge. Build coverage that travels with the architecture rather than fighting it.
  • Treat usability and stability as first-class quality concerns alongside functional correctness. Our interfaces must be intuitive, accessible, and dependable; your tests should help us prove all three.
  • Use AI aggressively as a force multiplier. Drive AI-assisted test authoring, suite generation, and maintenance so that one senior engineer can credibly cover the full surface area of a complex product. We expect the toolchain you build to look meaningfully different from a traditional QA program because of how you apply AI.

Cross-Functional Team Craft

  • Embed on a cross-functional Platform team alongside front end engineers, back end engineers, a data engineer, a designer, and a product manager. We share ownership over outcomes for our users — quality is the team’s job, and your job is to make sure the team is equipped to do it well.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies as the customer and quality voice in the room. Bring a QA lens to story refinement: what could break, what the edge cases are, what “done” really means. Then implement the automated tests that ship with each story.
  • Be the catcher on the field — the engineer who sees the whole game, anticipates what’s coming, and quietly guides the team toward better outcomes. Mentor by example: through the quality of your tests, the clarity of your reviews, and your willingness to sit shoulder-to-shoulder with another engineer when something is hard.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with a deep specialization in test automation, or equivalent experience as a Senior/Staff/Lead SDET, SET, or Quality Engineer at companies that treat testing as an engineering discipline.
  • Demonstrated track record of architecting a testing practice from early stage to mature — selecting frameworks, building suites, integrating them into CI/CD, and earning the trust of the engineering organization over time.
  • Phenomenal hands-on coding ability. You write production-quality code, and your tests look like production code: well-factored, well-named, easy to maintain, and built to last.
  • Strong experience with Playwright (or comparable modern end-to-end frameworks such as Cypress or Selenium) and a clear point of view on when and how to use them.
  • Deep experience with API testing and contract testing, including testing the seams between your application and critical third-party APIs. You know how to mock, stub, and record/replay responsibly, and when each is appropriate.
  • Experience designing and running performance and load testing programs, with the judgment to choose the right tooling for the workload (k6, JMeter, Gatling, Locust, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to testing workflows — AI-assisted test authoring, suite generation, self-healing tests, AI-driven coverage analysis, or comparable approaches. You are fluent with modern AI coding tools and treat them as core to your craft.
  • Strong experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with ArgoCD, Kubernetes, and containerized test environments is a plus; the ability to learn our specific stack quickly is required.
  • Working knowledge of the .NET and Next.js ecosystems sufficient to read and reason about the code you are testing. You don’t need to be a .NET expert; you do need to be comfortable in the codebase.
  • A clear point of view on accessibility (WCAG) and usability testing, and the experience to back it up.
  • Excellent communication. You can explain a coverage gap, a flaky test, or a release risk to engineers, product partners, and executives with equal precision.

Skills & Competencies

  • Quality as Engineering: You treat testing as a software engineering discipline. Everything is code, everything is reviewable, everything belongs in the pipeline.
  • AI Fluency: You use AI as a force multiplier across your work and have strong opinions about where it adds real leverage and where it doesn’t.
  • Architectural Thinking: You design test architectures that match the systems they cover — simple where the system is simple, layered where it is layered, evolvable where it must evolve.
  • Pragmatic Bar-Raising: You raise the quality bar without becoming a bottleneck. You know when to write the test, when to teach the engineer to write it, and when to let it ship.
  • Mentorship by Example: You raise the people around you through the quality of your work, the clarity of your reviews, and your willingness to dig into a hard bug alongside the engineer who wrote the code.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You partner naturally with engineering, product, design, data, and DevSecOps, and you treat those partnerships as core to the work rather than adjacent to it.
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Relentless focus on the artist experience. You think about usability, accessibility, and stability the way the customer would — because in the end, that’s what your tests are protecting.
  • Clear Communication: You can articulate risk, coverage, and trade-offs to engineers, product partners, and executives with equal precision — in writing, in reviews, and in person.

Location

Remote within the United States. This role works on Pacific Time hours to maintain strong overlap with the Platform team.

Reporting Structure

This role reports to the Director of Engineering.

Compensation

CD Baby provides base salary ranges for all positions located in the United States at the time of posting. The hiring range for this position is $160,000 – $180,000 annually. As a candidate for this position, your salary and related elements of compensation will be contingent upon various factors including, but not limited to, work experience, geographic location, and relevant skills. Downtown is committed to providing a comprehensive market-competitive total rewards program for its employees which includes medical, dental, and vision, life insurance, 401(k) match, and generous paid time off. This range does not include any other variable compensation components.

Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.

Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.

Make an impact — from near or far

At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.

The opportunity

The Director, Information Security Engineering will report to the Deputy Chief Information Security Officer. You will lead the university's security architecture and engineering strategy, modernizing platforms, practices, and operating models to deliver scalable, resilient, and effective security capabilities. You will improve adoption of modern security architectures, cloud-native approaches, and AI-enabled security capabilities that strengthen the institution's ability to manage evolving threats.

You will bring deep technical credibility to lead senior architects and engineers, a demonstrated track record of leading transformation in complex organizations, and the vision to align security architecture and engineering investments with institutional priorities, modern technology environments, and emerging risk.

You will work 100% remotely from any of our approved states.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive organizational and cultural change within the team, promoting a growth mindset, accountability, and engineering excellence while building alignment and demonstrating measurable progress.
  • Establish and promote modern security engineering practices, including infrastructure-as-code, security-as-code, zero trust architecture, and DevSecOps integration across the university's technology ecosystem.
  • Be an internal change agent, advocating for security modernization across ITS and with university leadership.
  • Provide authoritative technical direction across security architecture and engineering disciplines, including network and cloud security, endpoint and data protection, application security, and security tooling platforms.
  • Lead the security architecture practice including defining clear service parameters, setting high technical standards, reviewing architecture decisions, and ensuring solutions are forward-looking, practical, and aligned to risk posture.
  • Own the university's enterprise security reference architecture, ensuring it reflects current threat landscapes, regulatory requirements (NIST 800-171, GLBA, FERPA, etc.), and modern delivery models including cloud-native and hybrid environments.
  • Evaluate, select, and oversee implementation of security technologies with disciplined focus on reducing complexity, improving efficacy, and enabling automation.
  • Establish and lead the ISMO's strategy for applying AI and machine learning to advance security engineering capabilities and tooling
  • Partner with governance, risk, privacy, and AI stakeholders to assess and address security risks introduced by AI adoption including shadow AI, generative AI data exposure, and risks introduced by autonomous AI agents operating within enterprise environments.
  • Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI security landscape and serve as a subject matter authority to the D-CISO, senior IT leadership, and AI leadership on both AI-enabled security and AI-security related risk.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation and AI to increase the team's capacity and capability without proportional headcount growth.
  • Partner with the Deputy CISO to define a multi-year Security Architecture and Engineering strategy, translating vision into actionable roadmaps, funded initiatives, and measurable outcomes.
  • Develop and present compelling business cases to the Deputy CISO and CISO to secure funding, headcount, and organizational support for strategic initiatives.
  • Build and manage a portfolio of security initiatives, ensuring alignment to institutional risk priorities, compliance obligations, and technology strategy.
  • Collaborate with the AVP of Governance, Risk, Compliance and Privacy to ensure architecture and engineering decisions are grounded in risk and that controls are implemented effectively and measurably.
  • Lead, develop, and retain a team of security architects, engineers, and managers — creating clear career paths, fostering technical excellence, and building a high-performing culture.
  • Design and evolve the team structure, capabilities, and leadership depth required to deliver the future-state vision, aligning talent and resources to strategic priorities while developing both managers and individual contributors.
  • Recruit and onboard talent capable of delivering the future-state vision, including individuals who bring skills the current team does not possess.
  • Set clear expectations for performance, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team.
  • Serve as a mentor and technical escalation point for architects and engineers navigating complex problems.
  • Advise the Deputy CISO, CISO, and ISMO leadership team on security architecture, engineering trends, and emerging risks.
  • Engage effectively with university stakeholders across business units, translating technical concepts into business and mission impact.
  • Represent the security architecture and engineering function in governance forums, project review boards, and vendor negotiations.

What We're Looking For:

  • 10+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience
  • 5+ years in a senior technical leadership role overseeing architecture or engineering functions.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent (i.e. GED)
  • Professional Certification(s): CISSP, ISC2 Certifications, GIAC.
  • Experience as a security engineer or architect across at least two core disciplines (Platform Security, Application Security, AI Security, Cloud/Infrastructure Security, Data Security, DSPM)
  • Experience securing Azure PaaS/IaaS, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Fabric, or similar.
  • Experience as an engineer or architect across multiple security domains: zero trust architecture, application security, cloud security (Azure), identity and access management, network security, endpoint protection, data security, and security automation.
  • Experience with AI and machine learning applications in cybersecurity, including familiarity with AI-enabled security tools, LLM-related risks, and emerging threats associated with enterprise AI adoption.

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if you're wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person we're looking for.

Compensation

The annual pay range for this position is $125,298.00 - $200,516.00. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $138,456.00 - $187,323.00.

Exceptional benefits (because you’re exceptional)

You’re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full-time employee at SNHU, you’ll get:

  • High-quality, low-deductible medical insurance

  • Low to no-cost dental and vision plans

  • 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays)

  • Employer-funded retirement

  • Free tuition program

  • Parental leave

  • Mental health and wellbeing resources

raw.description:
Description

AgencyBloc is a leading provider of agency management solutions built specifically for life and health insurance agencies. Our platform helps agencies streamline operations, strengthen client relationships, and drive growth through powerful CRM, commission processing, and marketing automation tools. We value innovation, collaboration, and making a meaningful impact in the industries we serve and we take pride in fostering a culture that genuinely cares about our customers, our work, and each other.

Requirements

Summary:

AgencyBloc is looking for a UX Designer to bring deep customer understanding to life through intuitive, well-crafted product experiences. This role is critical to ensuring that what we build is not only functionally right — but simple, coherent, and easy to use for health and benefits agencies.

This person will own and execute the design layers that make products truly work — rolling up their sleeves to do the hands-on design work that takes a product from concept to something Technology can build with confidence. The role goes well beyond visual polish to shape how customers think about, feel, and move through the product. Working closely with our UX Strategist & Researcher, Product Management team, and Technology team, you’ll actively shape the problem, direction, and solution, then translate customer understanding and product strategy into designs that resolve ambiguity, ensure those delight customers, answer engineering's questions before they're asked, and set a consistent standard for what great UX looks like at AgencyBloc.

Ultimately, this role ensures that AgencyBloc products are deeply usable, visually cohesive, and grounded in a genuine understanding of how our customers work.

Responsibilities:

UX Design

  • Lead and execute end-to-end design across the full UX spectrum — doing the hands-on work across conceptual models, information architecture, and interaction design — going well beyond how something looks to define how it works.
  • Define how users navigate, interact with, and mentally model the product — applying deep interaction design principles to create experiences that feel natural and effortless
  • Take vision and definition from Product and UX and make it buildable and coherent — resolving ambiguity, surfacing gaps, and producing designs that answer most of Technology's questions before they're asked
  • Define what "good UX and UI" looks like at AgencyBloc — establishing design patterns and interaction guidelines that keep the product feeling consistent and unified as it grows
  • Serve as the design conscience for the organization — the person Product Managers and engineers turn to when they need to know if something is right
  • Bring a thoughtful, structured approach to design work — moving intentionally from customer understanding through concept, iteration, and validation — and use AI tools deliberately to accelerate the process without losing sight of what customers actually need

Customer Driven

  • Develop and maintain a genuine, ongoing understanding of how AgencyBloc customers think, work, and experience the product — bringing that understanding early and often into the design process to guide every design decision from concept through delivery
  • Partner with the UX Strategist & Researcher to engage customers at every fidelity level — from rough concepts and sketches through high-fidelity prototypes — and stay connected to findings, customer interviews, and usability insights
  • Build low to high fidelity prototypes that test real understanding and interaction, not just communicate ideas to stakeholders
  • Incorporate customer learnings continuously — treating feedback as an ongoing input to design, not a final review step

Collaborative by Design

  • Work in close partnership with Product Managers, the UX Strategist & Researcher, Technology, and cross-functional partners — treating design as a team sport where the best outcomes come from working together early and often
  • With Product Management, engage deeply in product discovery and definition to understand not just what is being built, but why and to design accordingly
  • With Technology, help inform shared components and what the front-end design standard should be — without necessarily owning the CSS/HTML themselves
  • Participate actively in Discovery, Planning, and Development phases — not just as a design resource, but as a full contributor to product decisions, with the authority to raise concerns, challenge direction, and advocate for the customer experience when the design isn't right
  • Communicate design decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, building alignment and confidence across the team
  • Serve as the UX design decision-maker for readiness — determining whether an experience is ready for development and validating that what ships matches the intended experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Customer-Centered Designer: Genuine curiosity about how users think and work. Designs from a deep understanding of the customer's world — not just the screen — and exercises exceptional judgement turning that understanding into design decisions that are customer-centered and practical. Comfortable engaging directly with customers to test and learn.
  • Conceptual & Interaction Design Depth: Strong command of the UX design spectrum from mental models and conceptual design through conceptual design, information architecture, and interaction design. Knows the difference between how something looks and how it works and is relentless about clarity, simplicity, and ease of use—especially for small businesses.
  • AI-Experience Designer: Comfortable designing product experiences that incorporate AI-enabled features and understanding the unique UX challenges AI presents. Approaches AI features with the same customer-centered rigor as any other part of the product.
  • Systems Thinker: Understands how individual design decisions compound across a product. Cares about consistency, scalability, and the long-term integrity of the design system. Can think at the component level and the product level simultaneously.
  • Cross-Functional Collaborator: Builds strong working relationships across Product, UX, Technology, and Client Experience. Skilled at influencing without authority through facilitation, storytelling, and clarity. An active contributor to shaping the problem and solution direction — partnering with Product and UX to define what needs to be solved, not just how to solve it.
  • Technology Collaborator: Comfortable working closely with architects and engineers. Understands enough about front-end implementation to have meaningful conversations about feasibility, component design, and design system maintenance — without owning the code.
  • Deliberate AI User: Uses AI tools intentionally as part of a structured design process — to accelerate concept generation, prototype iteration, and design exploration — while keeping customer understanding at the center of every decision.
  • Cultural Fit: Thrives in a collaborative, people-centered, fast-moving remote environment. Comfortable with ambiguity and change. Brings curiosity, humility, and a learning mindset to the work.

Skills/Education/Experience:

  • 15+ years of experience in UX or product design in a SaaS or technology-driven environment
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating depth across conceptual design, information architecture, interaction design, and visual design
  • Excellent working knowledge of user experience design principles and modern product development practices.
  • Proficiency in Figma or equivalent design tooling
  • Experience contributing to or owning a design system
  • Comfort working with engineers on front-end design standards and component decisions
  • Experience working in agile or iterative product development environments.
  • Excellent communication skills — able to explain design decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; relevant experience considered in lieu of degree
  • Some travel may be required for in-field customer research.

Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States.

At ELVTR, we're transforming online education by connecting ambitious professionals with industry leaders from companies like Nike, Netflix, Google, Amazon, and more.

Since launching in 2020, we've grown into a global learning community with over 300 expert instructors, delivering more than 200 live online courses across 12 industries. To date, we've helped 22,000+ graduates worldwide gain the skills, confidence, and connections needed to advance their careers.

Now we're looking for an experienced Lead Retention Specialist to help us build lasting relationships with our learners while maximizing customer satisfaction and long-term revenue. This is a full-time, remote role with a working schedule for this role will be 9AM-6 PM EST.

Why This Role Is Different

At ELVTR, customer relationships don't end after enrollment—they're just beginning. As our Lead Retention Specialist, you'll play a critical role in protecting the customer experience while driving sustainable business growth.

You'll take ownership of our retention strategy, helping customers find the best possible solutions while reducing refunds, recovering revenue, and improving long-term customer loyalty. Working closely with Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Billing, and Operations, you'll use data, empathy, and strategic thinking to continuously improve our retention processes and outcomes.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken
  • Proven experience supporting customers in the US market
  • Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills with a track record of reducing refunds and recovering revenue
  • Experience managing refund requests, payment recovery, billing issues, and installment collections
  • Ability to navigate difficult customer conversations with empathy while protecting company interests
  • A data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze retention metrics and identify opportunities for improvement

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Experience collaborating with Sales, Billing, Finance, Customer Success, and other cross-functional teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience in the online education or EdTech industry
  • Experience in high-ticket B2C sales environments
  • Previous experience leading or mentoring a retention team
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems
  • Experience working with subscription or installment payment models
  • Knowledge of billing operations, chargebacks, and payment recovery processes
  • Experience analyzing customer retention metrics to drive business improvements
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment
  • Experience collaborating across Sales, Finance, Product, and Customer Success teams
  • Familiarity with AI-powered customer support or sales tools, including conversation intelligence platforms

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation:Competitive salary,Performance-based bonuses,Opportunities for career advancement as ELVTR continues to grow globally
  • Learn and Grow:Free access to ELVTR courses,Ongoing professional development opportunities,Career growth within one of the world's fastest-growing online education companies
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from wherever you're most productive, Flexible and supportive work environment,Collaborative international team

Why Join ELVTR?

  • Make an Impact:Every course you help create empowers professionals to build new skills, advance their careers, and unlock opportunities they never thought possible.
  • Grow Your Career:We're committed to developing our people. As ELVTR continues to expand globally, you'll have opportunities to grow professionally, take on new challenges, and shape the future of online education.
  • Join a Winning Team:Work alongside passionate educators, creators, marketers, and innovators who are committed to delivering world-class learning experiences and making education more accessible around the world.

Ready to Help Shape the Future of Online Learning?

If you're looking for more than just another customer retention role—if you want to build meaningful customer relationships, solve complex challenges, and make a measurable impact on both learners and business growth—we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of ELVTR's next chapter of growth.

A Technical Account Manager III (TAM) is a complex role, operating with significant autonomy, ownership and technical judgement to make recommendations that carry meaningful cost and relationship implications for our customers. A TAM is part product manager, part relationship manager, part technical expert, and part customer whisperer. Success in this position requires strong relationship management skills, a high degree of technical competency, an organized ownership mindset, and the ability to mobilize cross-functional teams to deliver technical solutions aligned with client objectives. The TAM will be the primary regional outpost of the Product team, balancing customer business needs against product priorities to help guide roadmap investment and ensure the right areas of focus for the Oceania market. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Deeply understand our clients’ business requirements in using the product(s), so you can help solve those in new and innovative ways, as well as guide the product team about regional priorities.

  • Identify and analyze underlying business requirements, providing expert recommendations on the most effective solutions and alternative approaches.

  • Maintain a deep understanding of each client’s environment, including its configuration and operational nuances, to provide informed, environment-specific support.

  • Take end-to-end accountability for complex technical investigations, owning the outcome regardless of how many teams are involved in getting there, keeping the teams focused on getting the right business outcome for your clients.

  • Proactively make it your mission to ensure that our clients have the best deployment configuration that we can bring to them. If you solve a problem before the clients knows it exists, you’re succeeding.

  • Drive investigations toward clear next actions, removing blockers and maintaining momentum on complex technical escalations.

  • Be accountable for making sure our product roadmap is as good as it can be for our regional cleints, noting that you don’t directly control it –use your skills to move the product team forward, helping them make trade-offs.

  • Validate and reconcile technical findings from multiple sources, ensuring recommendations are evidence based, technically sound, and commercially appropriate before being communicated to clients.

  • 7+ years of experience managing complex technical accounts or programs in the software industry, with preference for healthcare IT environments.

  • Experience with React/PHP/SQL Server stack

  • Strong technical aptitude with working knowledge of healthcare IT systems, integrations, medical imaging workflows, and interoperability standards (DICOM, HL7, FHIR, or IHE)

  • Exceptional relationship management skills with the ability to build credibility at both technical and executive levels

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional working sessions with clear outcomes, accountability, and follow-through

  • Experience troubleshooting applications, hardware, drivers, OS, networking services etc. 

  • Experience mobilizing cross-functional teams to execute planned business outcomes and strategic initiatives

  • Available for client engagement across multiple Australian time zones and occasional travel to client sites

  • Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive healthcare data in strict compliance with applicable privacy regulations

  • Ability to manage multiple complex accounts concurrently in a fast-paced environment

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Intelerad products or equivalent healthcare IT platforms a plus

What We Can Achieve Together:

The Global Director of Indigenous and Community Leadership in Conservation (ICLC) is abold, strategic, and visionary leaderresponsible for advancing one of TNC’s most critical global priorities.

Reporting to the Global Managing Director, Equitable Conservation, this position will lead aglobalteam andis responsible foradvancing Indigenous and Community Leadership in Conservationas a cross-cutting transformative practiceacross TNC. The Directorsupervises a small, specialized global unit andworks through a complex matrix of regional, country, and global teams, providing strategic leadership, influence, and coordination to advance shared conservation outcomes with and for Indigenous Peoples, Tribal Nations, and local communities.

This role will:

  • Drive aglobal strategy that advances Indigenous and community leadership across TNC’s conservation work

  • Shape how TNCdelivers onits 2030goalsand beyond throughequitable, durable, and community-led outcomes

  • Influence systems, financing, partnerships, and governance to align withself-determined stewardship and rights-based approaches

  • Partner with Equitable Conservation teammates on avision of biocultural restorationfor the planet

The Global Director, ICLC operates at the most senior levels of the organization, leading across boundaries to catalyze change at scale and position TNC as a global leader in shifting power to communities.

We’re Looking for You:

The Global Director,ICLCleads the design and execution of a global transformative practice that crosscutsall ofTNC’s work.

The Director leads a global team of ~6 staff, works across regions and functions, and engages senior internal and external stakeholders to accelerate a shift toward conservation models rooted in equity, rights, and local leadership. They lead the global strategy of Indigenous and Community Leadership in Conservation, partnering closely with regional and global teams as well as local communities, rightsholders and stakeholders to deliver conservation outcomes that respect and advance Indigenous rights and sovereignty.They will manage a team toward a vision of self-determination.

They provide strategic direction, organizational influence, and management oversight to ensure that Indigenous and community leadership is embedded in conservation outcomes, partnerships, and systems.They also have theability to understand enabling conditions as they shift, and adjust strategy and team accordingly, while grounded in global community reality and expectations.

They serve as the primary spokesperson for TNC to internal and external audiences (including staff, volunteers, Board of Trustees, public and private donors, government agencies and officials, communityleadersand other partners) and cultivates these audiences to support andpromote TNC’s mission and vision.

This role is remote and can be based in any country where TNC has an entity and room for additional employees.

This role may include travel up to 25% oftotaltime.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

Global Strategy & Transformation

  • Lead and evolve TNC’s global ICLC strategy, ensuring alignment with team and organizational priorities as well as external movements

  • Translate vision intoactionable frameworks, priorities, partnerships and investments, including evaluation and adaptive management

  • Drive integration of ICLC across conservation, climate and policy programs and influence high-level decision-making

Systems Change & Organizational Influence

  • Embed Indigenous and community leadership into core programmatic strategies

  • Advance strategies for governance and decision-making, funding allocation and finance mechanisms, and external partnerships

  • Position ICLC as a central driver of conservation impact and organizational transformation, influencing global and regional conservation strategies and outcomes

  • Strengthen organizational capacity to partner effectively with Indigenous Peoples and local communities

Team Leadership & Capacity Building

  • Lead and manage a global, multi-disciplinary and geographically dispersed team

  • Build a high-performing, inclusive culture aligned with TNC’s values

  • Serve on Conservation Leadership Team and Equitable Conservation Leadership Team as anexpert onIndigenous-led approaches

  • Develop a succession plan for ICLC leadership

Partnerships & External Leadership

  • Serve as a global thought leader and spokesperson for Indigenous and community-led conservation

  • Build and sustain partnerships with Indigenous leaders and community organizations, as well as global NGOs, multilaterals and funders

  • Represent TNC in global forums and influence the broader conservation and climate fields

Resource Mobilization & Delivery

  • Advance and support global fundraising and donor engagement strategies

  • Align resources and investments with ICLCglobalpriorities

  • Ensure effective delivery of programs and measurable conservation outcomes

Cross-Organizational Leadership

  • Collaborate across Equitable Conservation and other TNC functions, such as Global Protect, Provide, Climate, Science, Policy and Public Funding and Impact Finance and Markets teams

  • Lead and contribute to enterprise-wide initiatives and cross-boundary efforts

  • Ensure strong alignment between global strategy and regional implementation

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree and minimum of 7 years of experience as a leader in the conservation arena, non-profit sector, advocacy, or related for-profit area

  • Majority of experience gained outside the U.S. with an emphasis on the global south along with a demonstrated commitment to developing and practicing global literacy (Please do not apply if you do not have this.)

  • Management experience including leading and managing aglobalmulti-disciplinary team

  • Experience working in or as a partner to global, matrixed organizations

  • Written and verbal fluency in English isrequired

  • People management experience, whether direct supervision or project supervision

  • Executive decision-making abilities and a bias for strategy-driven approaches

  • Experience communicating with and presenting to diverse audiences including donors, board members, employees, outside partners, or equivalent

Desired Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree and minimum of 10+ years’ experience as a proven leader in the conservation arena, advocacy, Indigenous and tribalgovernanceor related area

  • Deep professional and/or lived expertise in Indigenous rights, community leadership, governance and/or equitable conservation

  • Extensive management experience including ability to motivate, lead, setobjectives, and manage performance of a large multi-disciplinary team towards established vision

  • Demonstrated ability to influence organizational strategy and systems

  • Success as an inspirational leader who has successfully motivated staff to achieve and sustain excellence. Proven managerial talent in budgeting, staffing, and performance management

  • Experience in fundraising and budget management

  • High energy, forward thinking, creative individual with high ethical standards. Outstanding leadership and visionary qualities and able to work effectively with and through others in a decentralized and geographically dispersed organization

  • Proven technical skills, analytical ability, good judgment, and strong operational focus. Demonstrated operational, implementation and detail-oriented perspective

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

raw.description:
Overview

What We Do

We calm the confusion of IT by guiding the connection between people and technology. If a customer is looking for a better way to manage their warehouse inventory, equip their workforce, or secure their data, we make it happen. All it takes is finding the right combination of tech hardware, software, cloud solutions, and support services. That’s what we do. We’re the IT Department’s IT Department.

Who We Are

Our team is made stronger by a multitude of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. It’s what makes Connection unique—what drives us to innovate and create technology solutions that stand apart from the crowd. We’d love for you to be a part of that fabric, to share your ideas and experiences with a team that thrives on fresh thinking, creativity, and helping others.

Why You Should Join Us

You’ll find supportive teammates and a rewarding career at Connection—plus great benefits. We take pride in supporting employees with a total rewards package that provides financial, emotional, and physical resources for you and your family. Our compensation, 401k plans, medical insurance, and other benefits are progressive and competitive. We value the importance of our employees’ emotional wellbeing. To support employees, we provide free therapy visits, mental health coaching and tools, and meditation resources. You’ll also enjoy a generous paid time off package that includes not only vacation and sick time, but also Wellness and Volunteer Time Off days.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Responsibilities

The Onboarding Inside Account Manager (OBIAM) is more than a sales training role—it's the launchpad for a successful career in enterprise technology sales. As an OIAM, you'll combine customer relationship management, consultative selling, and operational excellence while learning from experienced Enterprise Account Executives (EAEs).

In this hybrid role, you'll serve as both an Inside Account Manager (IAM) and Client Experience Specialist, helping new customers experience the best of Connection from day one. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives, manufacturers, distribution partners, and internal support teams to onboard customers, uncover new business opportunities, drive revenue growth, and deliver exceptional service throughout the customer lifecycle.

If you're motivated by building relationships, solving business challenges, and developing a career in technology sales, this role offers hands-on experience, mentorship, and a clear path for growth.

What You'll Do

Create Exceptional First Impressions

You'll lead a world-class onboarding experience that helps new customers quickly realize the value of partnering with Connection.

  • Deliver a personalized, "white glove" onboarding experience for new enterprise clients.
  • Introduce customers to their dedicated Connection team and available resources.
  • Demonstrate our technology solutions, customer portal, reporting capabilities, and self-service tools.
  • Understand each customer's business priorities, challenges, and strategic initiatives.
  • Configure customer portals, standards, and purchasing workflows to align with business needs.
  • Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders from the very beginning.

Develop into a Trusted Sales Advisor

Working alongside experienced Enterprise Account Executives, you'll learn to identify opportunities, support sales initiatives, and contribute to business growth.

  • Support one or more Enterprise Account Executives with proactive sales activities.
  • Develop and manage customer quotes, including technically configured solutions.
  • Maintain a four-hour response goal for customer quote requests.
  • Register opportunities and manage deal registrations with manufacturer partners.
  • Follow up on active proposals and sales opportunities.
  • Identify cross-sell, upsell, and whitespace opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct spend analysis and proactively recommend new technology solutions.

Build Strong Customer Relationships

You'll become a trusted business partner by providing responsive service and strategic account support.

  • Maintain ongoing communication with customers, manufacturers, distributors, and internal teams.
  • Build relationships across multiple customer departments and decision-makers.
  • Help customers maximize the value of their technology investments.
  • Partner with customers on pricing strategies, standards management, and procurement optimization.
  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and proactive account recommendations.

Lead Operational Excellence

You'll coordinate the resources needed to deliver a seamless customer experience from quote through fulfillment.

  • Oversee daily account activity to ensure timely order processing and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Inside Sales Support to maintain order accuracy and meet shipment expectations.
  • Assist with pricing reviews, order escalations, and complex open-order management.
  • Support return merchandise authorization (RMA) escalations.
  • Ensure Salesforce opportunities remain accurate and current.
  • Analyze customer activity and prepare meaningful business reports.

Collaborate and Lead

As your knowledge grows, you'll become a key resource for both customers and teammates.

  • Coordinate activities across Sales, Operations, Customer Support, and manufacturer partners.
  • Mentor and guide Inside Sales Support Representatives on customer priorities.
  • Share best practices and contribute to team success.
  • Support new Enterprise Account Executives during onboarding by introducing company resources, sales processes, and operational tools.
  • Help accelerate new EAE productivity through coaching, collaboration, and ongoing support.

What Success Looks Like

Successful OIAMs:

  • Build lasting customer relationships based on trust and responsiveness.
  • Deliver an outstanding onboarding experience that drives customer confidence.
  • Identify and develop new revenue opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Meet or exceed sales, gross profit, and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Collaborate effectively across teams to deliver seamless customer experiences.
  • Continuously grow their sales, technical, and business knowledge.

Why Join Connection?

At Connection, you'll gain exposure to enterprise technology sales while working alongside experienced professionals who are invested in your success. You'll receive hands-on training, mentorship, and opportunities to build meaningful customer relationships, develop consultative selling skills, and grow into increasingly strategic sales roles.

If you're driven by learning, collaboration, and delivering exceptional customer experiences, this is an opportunity to build a rewarding career with a company that values innovation, partnership, and continuous growth.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities and qualifications for this position. Duties and responsibilities may evolve to meet business needs.

Min

USD $22.84/Hr.

Max

USD $28.89/Hr.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • Strong customer service, sales support, account management, or inside sales experience.
  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and ERP systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise or B2B technology customers.
  • Knowledge of IT hardware, software, cloud, or technology solutions.
  • Experience preparing solution quotes and managing complex sales opportunities.
  • Understanding of manufacturer partner programs, pricing strategies, and deal registration.
  • Experience with customer onboarding, account growth, or consultative sales.

Work Environment

This is a remote position requiring a dedicated home office environment. Candidates should be comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams through virtual communication tools.

Some flexibility in working hours may be required to support customers across multiple time zones.

Travel

  • Occasional travel for customer meetings, training, or company events.
  • Approximately 10–20% travel may be required.

raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for skilled Bot Developers (WhatsApp Business API, Telegram Bot API, Discord API) to join the Tendem project () and build conversational bots and messaging-platform integrations for real-world applications. In this role, you'll use your bot engineering expertise, conversational design skills, and quality-focused approach to build reliable, useful bots and messaging integrations that deliver a great user experience. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience building messaging bots, working with platform APIs and webhooks, and implementing conversational logic.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Bot Developer, you'll design, build, and refine messaging bots for one or more messaging platforms, including WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and similar platforms — for use cases such as customer service, appointment booking, order taking, content delivery, moderation, and automated notifications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bots for one or more messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp (Business API / Cloud API), Telegram (Bot API), Discord, Slack and similar messaging platforms.
  • Design and implement conversational flows, dialogue state, and fallback handling.
  • Integrate bots with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for natural language responses where appropriate.
  • Connect bots to backend services, databases, CRMs, and third-party APIs (booking systems, payment, content sources).
  • Handle webhooks, rate limits, and platform-specific message formats (interactive messages, buttons, media, templates).
  • Review, debug, optimize, and refactor bot implementations to improve correctness, reliability, maintainability, and graceful error handling.
  • Implement logging, monitoring, and recovery so bots stay healthy in production.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience backend, integration, automation, or bot development experience (required).
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong foundation in bot development, messaging platform integrations, and building reliable conversational workflows. We are looking for specialists who can design and maintain production-ready bots, work confidently with APIs, webhooks, and backend services, and build stable, user-friendly bot experiences. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience building bots for at least one major messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, or similar) is required
  • Strong command of Python or Node.js for backend bot logic.
  • Solid experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and async request handling.
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases for storing conversation state and user data.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt design for conversational use is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of platform-specific limits, message templates, and approval flows (e.g., WhatsApp template messages).
  • Experience with hosting and deployment (Docker, serverless, VPS, or PaaS)

Additional requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to bot reliability — no silent failures, no broken flows.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to design and ship complete bots independently.
  • Portfolio or examples of bots you've built (required).
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

🧭 Navigating the position: Instructional Designer

We are seeking a creative and experienced Instructional Designer to craft impactful and memorable learning experiences.
Collaborating with the Product Managers, Visual Designers, Courseware Developers and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), you will design and implement effective learning journeys that optimise user engagement and efficiency.
This role requires a strong understanding of educational design principles, a keen eye for detail and a learner-focused approach to address diverse learning needs. Working closely with SMEs, you will translate our customer requirements into creating engaging content that aligns with company goals and instructional design standards. You will also be instrumental in the refurbishment of our legacy library into innovative, engaging and highly interactive eLearning for a maritime audience across the globe.
By partnering with cross-functional teams and leveraging user feedback, you will ensure continuous improvement and innovation in our learning solutions, delivering a seamless and highly efficient learning experience.

**Please not this will be an 18 month fixed term contract**

Key Responsibilities

Needs Analysis
  • Conduct thorough needs assessments to identify learning gaps and objectives.
  • Work with subject matter experts (SMEs) to validate assumptions.

Content Development
  • Create engaging and interactive online learning materials.
  • Collaborate with SMEs to structure and define learning content.
  • Determine optimal methods and multimedia combinations for delivering eLearning content.
  • Specify activities and instructions to accommodate diverse learning styles.
Technology Integration
  • Utilise and recommend authoring tools and learning technologies to deliver innovative and effective learning solutions.
Assessment & Evaluation
  • Partner with the Learning Experience (LX) Manager to develop assessment strategies to measure learning effectiveness.
  • Evaluate the impact of training programs.
Cross-Functional Working
  • Collaborate with SMEs, stakeholders, and team members to ensure training content accuracy and relevance.
  • Self-manage instructional design efforts, including timelines and resources.
  • Distribute accurate production requirements to visual designers.
  • Liaise with content engineers to ensure seamless production.
Continuous Improvement
  • Stay updated on emerging trends and best practices in instructional design and learning technologies.
  • Share articles, events, ideas, and methodologies with the design team to improve processes and outputs.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Educational Attainment
  • A professional qualification in instructional design.
Professional Background
  • Experience working collaboratively in a team environment.
  • A pragmatic understanding of managing high-quality content with a professional and resilient attitude toward handling diverse individuals.
Expected Areas of Competence
  • Empathy and Learner-Centric Design: Ability to understand the learner’s needs and create optimal learning experiences through well-structured learning journey roadmaps.
  • Learning Production Expertise:Proficiency in learning production processes, including ADDIE and agile practices.
  • Visual Storytelling: Mastery of visual storytelling to craft compelling and engaging educational content.
  • Conceptualisation and Problem Solving: Strong conceptual and analytical skills with a keen eye for detail.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Exceptional communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments.
  • Commitment to Quality: A passion for maintaining high standards of quality in all design work with an eye for detail.

This role is perfect for a creative thinker who enjoys working in a collaborative setting and is committed to delivering high-quality, impactful learning solutions.

raw.description:
About the Role

The Principal Healthcare Supply Chain Specialist (Information Technology/Clinical Information Systems) oversees work on multi-layered projects related to healthcare information technology systems and software such as pharmacy automation solutions, clinical decision support systems, laboratory information systems, perioperative environments, enterprise imaging software solutions, artificial intelligence technologies, and other software and systems used within hospital environments. The role works closely with hospital clients, clinicians, clinical engineers, IT teams, manufacturers, and Starita’s analysts to evaluate and compare healthcare technology vendors and solutions. The role leads hospital equipment and IT sourcing projects, including coordinating calls with Staritas' analysts, clinical engineers, and clients; developing RFP questionnaires; reviewing vendor RFP responses; and making purchase decision recommendations based on technical specifications, quoted pricing, and proposed service and support options. The Specialist will be responsible for reviewing, editing, and approving reports to ensure technical accuracy and proper clinical focus before they are sent to clients. In addition, the Specialist will work with Team Managers to develop new reports and service offerings, will support the Sales team by performing demos, providing sales pitch, and selling strategies, and may represent the company by attending and presenting at trade shows and conferences. The Principal Healthcare Supply Chain Specialist (Information Technology/Clinical Information Systems) is a subject matter expert who can assist in all aspects of developing and leading the Global Supply Chain Solutions team in its efforts to represent Staritas' mission-driven values and to continue meeting the evolving needs of Staritas’ member organizations.

Essential Functions

  • Analyzes information technology price quotations for equipment and software from a financial perspective and provides hospitals with information and resources to facilitate price negotiations with vendors.
  • Analyzes utilization trends across departments and/or facilities to identify opportunities for utilization optimization that may result in cost savings and/or reduced waste.
  • Analyzes market alternatives and market share data to identify potential opportunities for standardization/market shifts to mitigate disruptions with technologies or supplies.
  • Identifies purchase, lease/rental, and service contract pricing benchmarks using Staritas' internal database applications.
  • Assists Staritas member facilities with IT capital equipment planning, and budgeting.
  • Routinely surveys client requests and feedback to identify trends, deficits, etc. Proactively encourages the use of services to clients in correlation with other requests when opportunities present themselves. Collect specific client feedback whenever possible.
  • Reviews/edits/approves comparative and market intelligence reports before they are sent to clients. Works with individual analysts as needed to ensure technical accuracy and proper clinical focus in all reports.
  • Oversees and coordinates work on large projects related to information systems, software, and services. Provides input and assistance on projects and reports involving multiple technologies.
  • Leads Sourcing projects and coordinates calls with Staritas analysts, clinical engineers, and clients. Develops new RFP questionnaires, reviews and analyzes vendor RFP responses, and makes vendor/product purchase recommendations based on technical specifications, quoted pricing, and proposed service and support options.
  • Works with Team Managers to develop new reports, as well as new service offerings to help the team keep evolving in meeting client needs.
  • Educates new analysts and team members on capital and supply databases, the Staritas website, and department protocols.
  • Assists during the interview, selection, and training process when new personnel are hired.
  • Serves as a liaison for development efforts related to GSCS, with regard specifically to development initiatives, testing, and issue resolution.
  • Supports sales teams using web conferencing to perform demos and provide additional sales pitch and selling strategies to help reps to close sales.
  • Establishes and maintains relationships with vendors, hosts technology demonstrations and webinars on updated and new products.
  • Attends and presents at trade shows and conferences relevant to their subject matter expertise to promote Staritas as a thought leader in the healthcare arena to help drive Staritas' continued growth and expansion.
  • Provides subject matter expertise within capital, supply, and services to be able to provide guidance throughout Staritas.
  • Ability to work well with colleagues across departments in the organization.
  • Demonstrates exceptional customer service, written communication, and presentation skills.
  • Establish and maintain excellent relationships with clients by routinely keeping them informed of project status and developments.

Qualifications

  • Five (5) or more years' experience in healthcare IT systems assessment, selection, procurement, and installation, and/or a related role as an experienced clinical advisor for IT systems development and user training (e.g., acute care nursing/nursing education or healthcare consulting background). Experience beyond general hospital supply chain is required.
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) or certifications in clinical informatics or business applications (preferred but not required).
  • High-level Familiarity with clinical and healthcare IT systems and software applications, clinical workflows, and terminology in the healthcare industry.
  • Familiarity with IT infrastructure, software development, and system integration.
  • Ability to translate clinical requirements into technical specifications.
  • Ability to conduct market research to stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in healthcare IT procurement, healthcare IT systems, and related devices and software.
  • Ability to lead, organize and manage multiple concurrent tasks related to clinical information system projects.
  • Knowledge of database management, data integration, and data analytics tools.
  • Ability to Identify, evaluate, and select vendors for healthcare IT solutions. Conduct thorough assessments of vendor capabilities and offerings.
  • Ability to meet virtually with healthcare IT professionals and project managers, lead meetings, and make recommendations related to the selection of healthcare IT systems and software solutions.
  • Ability to express self effectively and concisely both orally and in writing and to quickly grasp the operating principles of previously unfamiliar technology.
  • Should be able to independently, reliably, and effectively manage changing priorities for multiple simultaneous tasks.
  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, information systems, healthcare information management (HIM), health informatics, or a related field. Clinical background (e.g., nursing, clinical engineering, medical technology) preferred to understand clinical workflows and challenges.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office 365 Suite of products (e.g., Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus program
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Comprehensive benefits package including 401k match
  • 19 days of PTO per year; 10 holidays per year
  • Opportunity to work in a mission-driven organization where your work directly shapes clarity, confidence, and better outcomes across healthcare

Travel

Up to 10% travel, based on business needs.  While our roles are 100% remote, we do get together a few times a year for up to one week.  Employees are given ample notice and attendance is expected.

Work Environment

This position operates in a professional work environment and requires the use of standard office equipment such as a computer, keyboard, mouse, webcam, and phone.

Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Statement

Staritas is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or veteran status.

As a federal contractor, Staritas complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding nondiscrimination and affirmative action. We are committed to creating a workplace that is fair, inclusive, and grounded in merit-based decision-making.

Accommodation Statement

If you need reasonable accommodation to apply for this position, please contact the recruiter.

Pay Transparency Statement
Staritas posts compensation ranges and benefits for all open roles. The compensation range for this position is $70,000 - $80,000, plus a comprehensive benefits package. Compensation offered will depend on factors including experience, skills, geographic location, and internal equity. Staritas does not retaliate against employees or applicants for discussing compensation.

Benefits Statement

Staritas offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial security of our employees. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings plans with company contributions; paid time off and company holidays; paid parental and family leave; and access to employee assistance and wellness resources. Additional benefits include life and disability insurance, professional development opportunities, and flexible work arrangements.

Learn more about us by visiting www.staritas.com.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

You'll own a portfolio of 4–6 fashion and apparel accounts. These clients move fast — seasonal drops, trend-driven creative, influencer campaigns that need to be in market in days, not weeks.

The growth constraints in fashion are usually one of three things: the brand is winning on product but losing on customer acquisition efficiency; they're acquiring customers but not retaining them; or their creative is outpacing their targeting strategy (or vice versa). Your job is to find which one it is, build the roadmap, and hold the team to it.

Responsibilities:

  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
  • Run quarterly Power Circuit reviews — diagnose growth constraints across Business, Audience, Product, Messaging, Channels, and Measurement, with close attention to creative performance and cohort retention trends
  • Maintain a working understanding of fashion business fundamentals, including pricing strategy, merchandising, and multi-channel distribution (DTC, wholesale, retail, marketplaces, etc)
  • Own the senior client relationship; QBRs should connect creative and campaign decisions back to business outcomes
  • Coordinate paid search, paid social, influencer, SEO, email, and creative teams — in fashion these functions depend on each other more than in most other verticals
  • Consult on customer retention strategy: repeat purchase rate, LTV by acquisition cohort, and loyalty mechanics
  • Manage retention and expansion; lead renewals; grow MRR
  • Build multi-threaded relationships with multiple layers of client contacts so no single point of contact departure puts an account at risk
  • Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Iris and nova), Pulse (client performance and sentiment tool) cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our diagnostic system) compliance across managed ADs
  • Coach and give direct feedback to analysts and specialists

Role Requirements:

  • 6+ years in fashion or apparel marketing, agency or brand side
  • Understands how creative strategy and media strategy interact — has an opinion on which comes first and why
  • Fluent in the influencer and UGC ecosystem: knows how to brief, evaluate, and scale it without losing brand control
  • Comfortable with DTC-first brands and understands the economics: CAC, LTV, repeat rate, margin by channel
  • Experience with Meta-heavy media mixes and the measurement challenges that come with them — incrementality testing, creative fatigue, audience saturation
  • Has worked with brands that move seasonally and knows how to build a strategy that accounts for it
  • Track record of retaining and growing accounts

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Expansion to Churn Ratio (ETCR)
  • Net MRR across portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Team Coaching and Development
  • Marketing Strategy, Development and Execution
  • Client Retention and Client Revenue Growth

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Robust Medical, Dental, Vision insurance plans with up to 100% employer contribution towards employee monthly premium
  • 401(k) plan - 4% employer contribution matching
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time $100 USD Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
